summary: this is a first party theme with a theme.json of css variables, a canvas background effect (effects.js built on effects-base.js) and a pixel mascot svg. the scripts only read css variables and draw on a canvas, with no network access, storage or cookie reads, eval, or imports outside the folder besides the sibling effects-base.js. the two webp images were not shown, which is expected for a theme. nothing damaging found.
